content:
The Library

Our school library is a quiet room at the end of the main building. It has many shelves filled with books on different subjects: storybooks, science books, history books, and dictionaries. The librarian, Mrs Adeyemi, is a kind woman who helps students to find the books they need. Every student is allowed to borrow two books at a time and keep them for two weeks. If a book is returned late, the student pays a small fine. Many students visit the library after classes to read or do their homework. Some students say the library is the best place in the school because it is quiet and full of knowledge. Mrs Adeyemi always reminds us that a library is a treasure house of knowledge.

content:
The Farmer and the Rain

Chief Okonkwo was a farmer in a village in the east. He planted yams, cassava, and maize on his large farm. One year, the rains did not come at the usual time, and the crops began to wither. The farmers in the village were worried. They held a meeting and decided to dig a small channel from the stream to their farms so that they could water their crops. They worked together for many days, and at last, water reached the farms. The crops recovered, and at harvest time, the yield was good. Chief Okonkwo told the young farmers that when people work together, they can overcome any difficulty.
